design.topology: 9-stage CMOS ring oscillator, single-ended, no output buffer
design.self_start_mechanism: deliberate stage-1 PMOS width asymmetry (3.8u vs 4.0u); oscillation establishes ~16 ns after ideal DC power-up with no stimulus and no .ic/.nodeset/uic anywhere

statuses.pvt_characterization: PASS (90/90 points, supplementary - not a signoff gate condition)

simulation_model_notes: GF180MCU ngspice library flattened: quoted model-card parameter expressions pre-evaluated to identical IEEE doubles under nominal sw_stat switches; verified operating-point equality and bit-identical 20 ns device transient vs the original library. Required because the stock library's per-iteration expression re-evaluation makes transients ~1000x slower.
PEX netlist declares ports as OSC_OUT VSS VDD; the simulation harness maps port order by name before instantiation.
notes: All LLM-side design decisions made directly by the agent; no external API refinement loop. Flow needed one harness fix (port order) between run 1 (TOOL_FAILURE) and run 2 (SUCCESS); circuit unchanged.
